ResearchProjectDef.label: resonance device
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the resonance device, which tunes to heroes from other worlds and lets a colonist become one hero's Host. Holds up to 100 charge, refills 5 per hour while powered, and supports 2 Hosts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: resonance tuning II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Sharpen the resonance device: up to 150 charge, 8 per hour refill, and 4 Hosts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: resonance tuning III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Sharpen the resonance device further: up to 200 charge, 12 per hour refill, and 6 Hosts.
